يختطفون (form VIII)
# يَخْتَطِفُونَ (yaḵtaṭifūna) /jax.ta.tˤi.fuː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِخْتَطَفَ (iḵtaṭafa)
# يُخْتَطَفُونَ (yuḵtaṭafūna) /jux.ta.tˤa.fuː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِخْتَطَفَ (iḵtaṭafa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
